card.name: "Time" after one or single
card.fires_on: The word "time" (or "-time", sometimes "dose") right after "one" or "single daily" in label text about once-only use or administration.

modes.label: one time
modes.description: "time" directly after "one" meaning a single occurrence, such as one-time dosing or a single vial puncture.
modes.example: Penetrate vial closure only one<< time>> with a suitable sterile transfer device or dispens

modes.label: one-time use
modes.description: "-time" in the hyphenated phrase for single-use vials.
modes.example: Each vial is for a one<<-time>> use in only one patient. Discard

modes.label: single daily dose
modes.description: "dose" completing a phrase about a single daily administration.
modes.example: Amoxapine may be given in a single daily<< dose>>, not to exceed 300
